Round-2 review of WP-SCP-022 v0.2.

You reviewed v0.1 in round 1 (your prior verdict CHANGES_REQUESTED with 3 CRIT, 4 MAJ, 1 MIN, 1 nit findings). v0.2 was authored by Opus orchestrator as the R1 fix-round, claiming to close every CRIT and unmitigated MAJ raised in round 1.

Apply the CORRECTNESS lens fresh against v0.2. You have not seen the fix-round narrative — only the resulting plan.

In addition to the standard correctness lens:

- Verify each R1 correctness finding is closed in v0.2 (or that v0.2 explicitly accepts the finding with mitigation):
  - C-CRIT-01 (020K missing from Track 1): check §3 Track 1 ordering and §9 PR count.
  - C-CRIT-02 (020D2 ordering inverted): check §3 Track 1 sequence — 020D1 → 020H part 1 → 020E.a → [USER-GATE-A0] → 020H part 2 → 020D2 should now be present.
  - C-CRIT-03 (020E.a wrongly described as FLA work): check §3 item 10 description.
  - C-MAJ-01 (020E.b/E.c silently dropped): check §3 'Track 1 deferred to post-pause continuation' explicitly names them.
  - C-MAJ-02 (020H part 1 wrongly includes ADOPT-001 §12 guide): check §3 item 9 and §3 'Track 1 deferred' — 020H part 3 should be in the deferred list.
  - C-MAJ-03 (§4.3 APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS(MIN/nit-only) undefined): check §4.3 decision table.
  - C-MAJ-04 (§4.3 session_id source unspecified): check §4.3 fix-round dispatch description and §6 / §14 FUP-022-01.
  - C-MIN-01 (§9 PR count update): check §9 lists 12 PRs for Track 1.
  - C-nit-01 (cost cap unquantified): check §8 R-022-07 and §13 U-022-01 — $30 per-slice / $300 aggregate.

- Apply the lens fresh to find new correctness issues introduced in v0.2 itself, especially:
  - Are the new helper scripts (`scripts/sanitize_review_finding.py`, `scripts/wp_scp_022_gate_check.sh`) referenced consistently throughout the plan?
  - Is the §4.7 gate-enforcement helper specification testable? Are exit codes documented?
  - Does the v0.2 ACC pin manifest at `docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/acc-pin-manifest.json` actually exist and contain the SHAs referenced in §6?
  - Does the new mid-chain USER-GATE-A0 break the autonomous chain coherently? Is the gate-helper's verification path correct for `release-signoff.md`?
  - Has anything else been silently dropped or altered in the v0.1 → v0.2 rewrite?

Return a SonnetReviewResult JSON. Verdict: APPROVED if all R1 CRITs/MAJs closed AND no new CRITs introduced; APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS if MIN/nit residuals only; CHANGES_REQUESTED if any CRIT or unmitigated MAJ remains.
